title: A bomb breaks the floor off the screen
description: In the Temple, the player drops a bomb beside a damsel and runs left until it's far out of the view. It goes off there, out of sight: the screen shakes. He walks back, and the floor where the bomb lay is gone, so he drops into the hole.
